# set1: the Panel's answers, verbatim (generated by tools/summary.py)

For each distinct answer: the HTTP status, `code` and `reason`, the API's own sentence (the API answers in English only), the values it carried, and the sentences the installed build's EN/TR catalogues hold for the screen (looked up by key; the driver does not render a screen).


## S1-cron: HTTP 409 `CRON_JOB_DUPLICATE`
- runs: set1-arch, set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S1c add the identical task
- API (EN): "A scheduled task with the same schedule and command already exists, so nothing was added. Change the existing task instead, or enable it if it is disabled."
- catalogue `err.CRON_JOB_DUPLICATE`
  - EN: "A task with the same schedule and command already exists, so nothing was added. Change the existing task instead, or enable it if it is disabled."
  - TR: "Aynı zamanlama ve komutla bir görev zaten var; bu yüzden hiçbir şey eklenmedi. Var olan görevi değiştirin ya da devre dışıysa etkinleştirin."

## S1-cron: HTTP 502 `CURRENT_SETTINGS_UNREADABLE` / `scheduled_tasks`
- runs: set1-arch, set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S1f list under the owner's spool-relocated; S1f add under the owner's spool-relocated; S1f list under the owner's cron-allow; S1f add under the owner's cron-allow
- API (EN): "CelikPanel could not read what is currently set on this server, so nothing was changed. Reload the page to read it again. If it keeps failing, the server owner checks that the service behind this page is running, then reloads."
- catalogue `cron.unknown`
  - EN: "The scheduled tasks of this domain could not be read from the server, so the list is not shown and tasks cannot be added or changed here. Nothing was changed; the tasks already on the server are untouched. Try again."
  - TR: "Bu domain'in zamanlanmış görevleri sunucudan okunamadı; bu yüzden liste gösterilmiyor ve buradan görev eklenemiyor ya da değiştirilemiyor. Hiçbir şey değiştirilmedi; sunucudaki görevlere dokunulmadı. Tekrar deneyin."
- catalogue `err.CURRENT_SETTINGS_UNREADABLE`
  - EN: "CelikPanel could not read what is currently set on the server, so nothing was changed. Reload the page and try again."
  - TR: "CelikPanel sunucuda şu an neyin ayarlı olduğunu okuyamadı; bu yüzden hiçbir şey değiştirilmedi. Sayfayı yenileyip tekrar deneyin."

## S1-cron: HTTP 409 `SETTINGS_CHANGED` / `scheduled_tasks`
- runs: set1-arch, set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S1d add with the version from before the owner's edit
- API (EN): "The settings changed on the server since this page loaded, so nothing was changed. Reload the page to see the current settings, then make the change again."
- catalogue `cron.stale`
  - EN: "The scheduled tasks changed on the server after this list loaded, so nothing was changed. Reload the list, then try again; a task you were typing stays in the form."
  - TR: "Zamanlanmış görevler bu liste yüklendikten sonra sunucuda değişti; bu yüzden hiçbir şey değiştirilmedi. Listeyi yeniden yükleyin, sonra tekrar deneyin; yazmakta olduğunuz görev formda kalır."

## S2-mail-policy: HTTP 502 `MAIL_POLICY_NOT_RELOADED`
- runs: set1-debian13; requests: S2f save while Postfix cannot reload
- API (EN): "The mail policy was saved to /etc/postfix/main.cf, but Postfix could not be reloaded, so Postfix is still running with the previous settings. Nothing was rolled back. The server owner runs sudo postfix check to see what Postfix objects to, corrects it, and then runs sudo systemctl reload postfix. Reload this page afterwards; the saved values are the ones shown."
- vars: `{"detail": "Job for postfix.service failed. See \"systemctl status postfix.service\" and \"journalctl -xeu postfix.service\" for details.; exit status 1"}`
- flags: `{"partial_success": true, "mutation_applied": true}`
- catalogue `err.MAIL_POLICY_NOT_RELOADED`
  - EN: "The mail policy was saved to /etc/postfix/main.cf, but Postfix could not be reloaded, so Postfix is still running with the previous settings. Nothing was rolled back. On the server, run sudo postfix check to see what Postfix objects to, correct it, then run sudo systemctl reload postfix. The values shown below are the saved ones."
  - TR: "Posta politikası /etc/postfix/main.cf dosyasına kaydedildi ancak Postfix yeniden yüklenemedi; bu yüzden Postfix hâlâ önceki ayarlarla çalışıyor. Hiçbir şey geri alınmadı. Sunucuda sudo postfix check komutuyla Postfix’in neye itiraz ettiğini görün, düzeltin, sonra sudo systemctl reload postfix komutunu çalıştırın. Aşağıda gösterilen değerler kaydedilen değerlerdir."
- catalogue `mailpolicy.reloadSaid`
  - EN: "The reload said:"
  - TR: "Yeniden yükleme yanıtı:"

## S2-mail-policy: HTTP 409 `MAIL_POLICY_RESTRICTIONS_UNMANAGED` / `variable`
- runs: set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S2e save a DNSBL zone over the ${variable} list
- API (EN): "The DNSBL setting was not changed: the recipient restrictions on this server refer to another Postfix setting ($name), so CelikPanel cannot tell which checks they contain and will not rewrite them. The server owner changes the reject_rbl_client entries of smtpd_recipient_restrictions in /etc/postfix/main.cf and runs sudo systemctl reload postfix. Then reload this page. Message size and the outgoing rate limit can still be saved here."
- catalogue `mailpolicy.dnsblLocked.variable`
  - EN: "DNSBL cannot be changed from this page: the recipient restrictions in Postfix refer to another setting ($name), so CelikPanel cannot tell which checks they contain and will not rewrite them."
  - TR: "DNSBL bu sayfadan değiştirilemiyor: Postfix’teki alıcı kısıtları başka bir ayara ($ad) başvuruyor; CelikPanel hangi denetimleri içerdiklerini bilemediği için onları yeniden yazmaz."
- catalogue `mailpolicy.dnsblLockedAction`
  - EN: "To change it, edit the reject_rbl_client entries of smtpd_recipient_restrictions in /etc/postfix/main.cf, run sudo systemctl reload postfix, then reload this page. Message size and the rate limit can still be saved here."
  - TR: "Değiştirmek için /etc/postfix/main.cf içindeki smtpd_recipient_restrictions değerinin reject_rbl_client girdilerini düzenleyin, sudo systemctl reload postfix komutunu çalıştırın, sonra bu sayfayı yenileyin. İleti boyutu ve hız sınırı buradan kaydedilebilir."

## S4-postgresql: HTTP 422 `CONFIG_INVALID` / `daemon`
- runs: set1-arch, set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S4c set work_mem to a value PostgreSQL refuses
- API (EN): "Nothing is changed: the service's own program read the new file and refused it. Correct what it names below and save again."
- vars: `{"detail": "invalid value for parameter \"work_mem\": \"eight-megabytes\"", "name": "work_mem"}`
- catalogue `dbconf.refused.daemon`
  - EN: "Nothing is changed: PostgreSQL read the new file and does not accept it. Correct what it names and save again."
  - TR: "Hiçbir şey değişmedi: PostgreSQL yeni dosyayı okudu ve kabul etmiyor. Adını verdiği yeri düzeltip yeniden kaydedin."

## S4-postgresql: HTTP 422 `CONFIG_INVALID` / `empty`
- runs: set1-arch, set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S4d save empty content
- API (EN): "Nothing was saved: the new content is empty, and CelikPanel does not replace a configuration file with nothing. Reload the page to read the file again, then make the change."

  - EN: "Nothing was saved: the new content is empty, and CelikPanel does not replace a configuration file with nothing. Reload the file, then make the change again."
  - TR: "Hiçbir şey kaydedilmedi: yeni içerik boş ve CelikPanel bir yapılandırma dosyasını boş içerikle değiştirmez. Dosyayı yeniden yükleyin, sonra değişikliği tekrar yapın."

## S4-postgresql: HTTP 422 `CONFIG_INVALID` / `lockout`
- runs: set1-arch, set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S4e remove the local rules (local administrator access)
- API (EN): "Nothing was saved: this change would take away the local administrator access to PostgreSQL (the rule that lets the server's own postgres account connect over the local socket). CelikPanel and the owner's console both use it. Keep a `local all postgres peer` rule above any rule that would refuse it, then save again."
- vars: `{"name": "denied"}`
- catalogue `dbconf.refused.lockout`
  - EN: "Nothing was saved: this change would take away the local administrator access to PostgreSQL, the rule that lets the server’s own postgres account connect over the local socket. CelikPanel and your own console both use it. Keep a “local all postgres peer” rule above any rule that would refuse it, then save again."
  - TR: "Hiçbir şey kaydedilmedi: bu değişiklik PostgreSQL’e yerel yönetici erişimini, yani sunucunun kendi postgres hesabının yerel soket üzerinden bağlanmasını sağlayan kuralı kaldırırdı. Onu hem CelikPanel hem de sizin konsolunuz kullanır. Onu reddedecek her kuralın üstünde bir “local all postgres peer” kuralı bırakın, sonra yeniden kaydedin."

## S4-postgresql: HTTP 502 `CONFIG_RELOAD_FAILED` / `not_restored`
- runs: set1-arch, set1-debian13, set1-ubuntu; requests: S4g save while the unit's reload fails
- API (EN): "The service could not reload with the new file, and CelikPanel could not put the previous file back with certainty. The server owner checks the file on the server; the copy named below holds the other version. Then reload the service (sudo systemctl reload <service>) and reload this page."
- vars: `{"detail": "Failed to reload set1-owner-pooler.service: Access denied", "name": "/var/lib/postgres/data/postgresql.conf.celikpanel-backup-20261008T215803Z"}`
- vars: `{"detail": "Failed to reload set1-owner-pooler.service: Unit set1-owner-pooler.service not found.", "name": "/etc/postgresql/17/main/postgresql.conf.celikpanel-backup-20261008T220904Z"}`
- vars: `{"detail": "Failed to reload set1-owner-pooler.service: Unit set1-owner-pooler.service not found.", "name": "/etc/postgresql/16/main/postgresql.conf.celikpanel-backup-20261008T214812Z"}`
- catalogue `dbconf.reloadFailed.notRestored`
  - EN: "PostgreSQL could not reload with the new file, and CelikPanel could not put the previous file back with certainty. What the server holds now is shown below. Check the file on the server, reload PostgreSQL there, then reload this page. The other version is kept on the server as:"
  - TR: "PostgreSQL yeni dosyayla yeniden yüklenemedi ve CelikPanel önceki dosyayı kesin olarak geri koyamadı. Sunucunun şu an tuttuğu dosya aşağıda gösteriliyor. Dosyayı sunucuda denetleyin, PostgreSQL hizmetini orada yeniden yükleyin, sonra bu sayfayı yenileyin. Diğer sürüm sunucuda şu adla duruyor:"
